jobs.employer_name: Allied Joint Support and Enabling Command (JSEC) Ulm NATO
jobs.description:
Shape security. Work internationally.

The NATO Headquarters Allied Joint Support and Enabling Command (JSEC) in Ulm is part of one of the world's most important security alliances. In a highly international environment, our employees make an important contribution to the collective security, stability, and cooperation of the alliance partners. Civilian experts make an indispensable contribution at the international level.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a

Staff Assistant Conference Services (SBM) (m/w/d)

What tasks will you be responsible for in particular?

• Support the building Manager for all JSEC buildings related to conferences, events, meetings and visits.

• Support preparation and execution of activities which require VTC, Briefing Rooms or other locations inside and outside the JSEC buildings.

• Support coordination of maintenance and repair measures for all JSEC buildings related to conferences, events, meetings and visits, including outside activities.

• Support for all Building related topics such as accompaniment of external craftsmen etc.

• Provide support and duties related to conference services as directed by Branch Head Protocol.

• Coordination of Conference Room bookings.

• Support the storage of furniture and equipment in the relevant buildings.

• Operate of all IT and VTC Systems within JSEC buildings (vocational training will be provided by JSEC) related to conferences, events, meetings and visits.

• General office work.

What should you bring with you?

• Secondary education and completed vocational training in a building / facility management related area.

• Proven job-related knowledge acquired through at least 3-year job related experience.

• Driving license equivalent to European class B.

• Good appearance and a natural manner with guests.

• Familiarity with common IT Software such as MS Office.

• Good written and oral communication skills in English and German.

• You can provide evidence of a current Sicherheitsüberprüfung (SÜ2) security clearance, or you must be willing to participate in an extended security clearance process in accordance with the Security Clearance Act. Successful completion of the security clearance is mandatory to take up duty for the advertised position.

• Citizenship from one of the 32 NATO member countries.

What do we offer?

• A job in an international and dynamic environment with a strong purpose.

• Collaboration with experts from numerous countries.

• Remuneration in accordance with the TV NATO collective agreement in conjunction with TV AL II classification C 5. Monthly base salary, before tax: 3.102,58 € (as of February 2026).

• Christmas and vacation bonuses.

• 38.5-hour working week.

• Employee canteen on site.

• Company pension scheme.

• Employee events.

Interested?

If you are interested in working in a multinational environment with strategic relevance, we look forward to receiving your application.

Please submit your complete application documents (cover letter, resume, relevant references) and mention your citizenship*

to jsec.recruiting@nato.int

* Citizenship from one of the 32 NATO member countries is required to be authorised to work for NATO.

If you have any questions, please contact

Thomas Kilbinger at 0731 – 16904117

Stuttgarterstr. 199

89081 Ulm

Date: 06/24/2026

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

What you'll build

As a Senior Cloud-Native Engineer (f/m/d), you will build and scale the critical backend infrastructure for the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP). Your work will directly impact how thousands of developers and global businesses create and run their applications. In this role, you’ll transform our cloud capabilities by taking ownership of services that are essential to SAP's strategy.

- Build and operate the highly-available, scalable microservices that form the backbone of the SAP Business Technology Platform.
- Architect and implement the central API gateway, handling massive-scale traffic, security policies, and observability for all of SAP's cloud products.

- Degree in Computer Science or a related field, with 5+ years of professional experience in backend or platform engineering.
- Expertise in an object-oriented language like Go (Golang), C++, Java, or Node.js. Go is preferred.
- In-depth, hands-on experience with cloud-native paradigms, including container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
- Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, or similar.
- Proficiency with monitoring and observability tools for distributed systems such as Elastic Stack, Prometheus, Grafana, or Dynat .
- Experience deploying and managing applications on cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.
- Fluent English language skills, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

Beneficial

- Experience in computer networking concepts, and specifically with a massive scale of network traffic.

Where you belong

You will join our skilled engineering team located in Berlin and Israel.

Our team fosters a highly collaborative and agile culture built on pair programming, test-driven development (TDD), and continuous delivery. This is a workplace where you will own services critical to SAP's success, work with cutting-edge open-source technologies, and grow your career alongside a supportive team of cloud experts. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

Airbus Defence and Space in Manching is looking for a

Eurofighter Simulator Operational Factors (d/m/w)

The Eurofighter Training and Simulation Department provides simulators and services for the Eurofighter (EF) Pilot Synthetic Training System (PSTS) within the Eurofighter programme. The Operational Factors (OF) is responsible to support all related operational factors activities within the Training and Simulation department.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Operational support for the Pilot Synthetic Training System (PSTS) project regarding integration and operational acceptance test
- Performance of operational tests in the Eurofighter cockpit and Instructor Operator Station
- Operational support for PSTS operational tests (Air/Air, Air/Surface)
- Operational support for national and international PSTS rollout activities
- Exploring on new technologies which will improve training and following up idea discussions/concept development with the Customer
- Attendance at the relevant technical and operational meetings
- Build operational Knowledge, Skills and Experience of new Eurofighter systems, functionalities and capabilities
- Operational Support for Germany (GE) National PSTS Upgrade Projects, for the introduction of networked combat training and the development of a Synthetic Environment as well as for Virtual Reality Training Solutions

Desired skills and qualifications

- Former fast jet Pilot or Weapon Systems Officer (WSO)
- Operational experience in fast, sophisticated, modern combat-jets with instructor and/or weapon-instructor qualification and experience
- Ability to work independently within set guidelines, if required, while maintaining
- Experience in national or international pilot training programs
- Familiarity with training systems, simulators, and/or aircraft systems
- Experience working with international military customers and industry partners
- Fluent in English; German is a plus

jobs.occupation: Data & AI Engineer (all genders), PharmaHera Service GmbH (Data-Warehouse-Analyst/in)
jobs.description: Deine neue Umgebung: Behind PharmaHera is Atida - one of Europe's leading online pharmacy groups, serving over 5 million customers across 9 countries. Together with the CEPD Group, we combine more than 25 years of pharmaceutical expertise with digital excellence to redefine the online pharmacy experience: We are building a trusted, personalized health ecosystem that guides people from prevention to cure - backed by medical expertise and driven by our conviction: Pharmacy is about people. Based in Berlin, we serve as the group's competence center for Germany and the Netherlands. As a specialized partner, we manage e-commerce, marketing, IT, and logistics for our local mail-order pharmacies, such as APONEO. Our European markets run on a single, standardized data platform (our Foundation layer). Your mission for the future: To transform this data infrastructure so it is not only usable by people, but specifically prepared for AI agents that read, analyze, and autonomously act on it. The role Reporting to the Data & AI Engineer Lead, you will own the data pipelines, datasets, AI agents and tools built on top of Foundation, and you will build most of them with AI agents as part of your toolchain. The role sits one level of abstraction above the code: you specify, review and take responsibility for systems rather than typing every line. Core responsibilities Pipeline development: build and optimize data flows in Apache Airflow, from our European markets into BigQuery. Modeling in BigQuery: implement tables and views in the Foundation layer, guaranteeing KPI comparability across Spain, France, Italy and Germany. Semantic layer and data contracts: keep business definitions consistent across dashboards, models and agents, and define the schema, granularity and quality a dataset guarantees. AI-assisted delivery: use Claude Code and the Anthropic API as your everyday engineering environment -- turn a requirement into a precise specification, let the agent produce the pipeline, then review, test and own the result. Building for agents: expose Foundation through MCP tools and skills so that AIDA and our decision agents can query it reliably. A dataset is finished when an agent can use it without being misled. Evaluation: build the evals, checks and monitoring that tell us whether an agent's output is correct. Unit tests are not enough for non-deterministic systems. Data products: design data products for management, finance, commercial, operations and marketing -- reusable across markets. Visualization and reporting: work with the business team on reports and consumable datasets in Apache Superset. Code and traceability: clean Python and SQL, with every task traceable through our GitLab-Coda integration. Agent-generated code included. Your Profile & Tech Stack What You Bring to the Role (Must-Haves): Education & Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering or Data Science. AI-Assisted Engineering: Regular, demonstrable use of an LLM coding agent (Claude Code or equivalent) in daily work, plus the technical judgment to critically review agent-generated code. Tech Stack & Cloud: Solid experience with Google Cloud Platform (especially BigQuery), Apache Airflow, strong SQL, data-oriented Python, and version control via Git/GitLab. Languages: Fluent English for daily collaboration within our international team. Mindset & Work Ethic: Strong analytical skills, an independent and results-focused approach ("you get the problem and context, the solution design is yours to propose"), and a commitment to deeply understanding code rather than using AI as a blind shortcut. What Rounds Off Your Profile (Nice-to-Haves): Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), LLM APIs, ClearML, Docker, or Apache Druid. Know-how in evaluating non-deterministic systems and using BI tools (ideally Apache Superset). Industry experience in the healthcare, pharmacy, or e-commerce sectors, plus basic knowledge of German. What we are not looking for Someone who ships code they cannot explain. Someone who needs a ticket with the solution already inside it or with full requirements in place. We act fast: you get the problem, the context and access -- the design is yours to propose. Someone who uses AI as a shortcut and doesn't understand the problem they are solving. Someone who only thinks short-term. We build future-proof solutions. What You'll Get Your Work Environment: Freedom to Shape Your Role from Day 1: A position of responsibility with real opportunities for growth, where you can proactively drive initiatives and actively help shape strategies. Permanent, Full-Time Position: Long-term prospects in a future-proof market. Agile Work Environment: A motivated, dynamic team and flat hierarchies with short decision-making paths that enable fast execution. Flexibility with Team Spirit: Flexible working hours and a hybrid work model (mobile work & in-office) - with a focus on our Berlin office to foster collaboration and team cohesion. Direct Mentoring: Close collaboration and mentoring by the Data & AI Engineer Lead in a technically demanding environment. Hands-on Production Tech Stack: Real-world experience with Airflow, BigQuery, Druid, GCP, and a modern production AI stack (Claude, MCP, Agents, Evals). Professional AI Tooling: First-class AI engineering tools come as standard equipment. Your Benefits at a Glance: Health & Mobility: Urban Sports Club membership at an unbeatable price and a heavily discounted BVG corporate transit pass for your daily commute. Exclusive Perks: Attractive employee discounts on our entire APONEO product range, access to a wide variety of corporate benefits, and a Selgros card. All-Round Care: An on-campus cafeteria, free fresh fruit, vegetables, and snacks every day, plus an unlimited coffee and tea flat rate. Your Compensation & Terms: For this full-time, permanent position, we offer an attractive, market-based, and competitive compensation package. We anticipate an annual gross salary between EUR45,000 and EUR55,000 p.a. Together, we will determine your exact positioning within this range through a transparent process based on the following criteria: Your relevant practical work experience in Data & AI Engineering. Your professional qualifications and specific additional skills. Our internal salary structure to ensure fairness within the team. Equal Opportunity & Fair Pay: We don't leave fair pay to chance. We compensate all team members in equivalent positions transparently and fairly, regardless of gender or any other personal characteristic. Ready to join? Ready to actively shape the future of e-commerce and data-driven healthcare at Atida? Apply now! We look forward to receiving your CV and your earliest possible starting date.

jobs.description:
Location: ERL S SP 11

Department: SE GT PRM TM

Job Grade: Germany - Non Senior Management ÜT-Kreis

Mode of Employment: Full Time or Part Time / Permanent

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As the Program Lead for Expert Communities & Innovation Platforms, you will play a pivotal role in strengthening the technical capabilities of Grid Technologies (GT) and Product & Resource Management (PRM) at Siemens Energy. A typical day involves leading the GT Expert Program, engaging with technical experts globally, and driving innovation through structured expert engagement models. You will connect experts with strategic technology initiatives, facilitate knowledge sharing, and promote cross-functional collaboration, all while enhancing Siemens Energy’s position as an industry thought leader.

How You’ll Make an Impact 
* Lead and evolve the GT Expert Program, including expert identification, nomination, and recognition processes
* Act as the primary interface to innovation and collaboration platforms, increasing participation in innovation challenges and campaigns
* Establish technical communities of practice and facilitate expert workshops and working groups
* Create and implement internal and external communication strategies to drive expert communication
* Support publication and dissemination of technical expertise, coordinating conference participation and technical representation
* Strengthen engagement of technical experts globally and promote cross-functional collaboration and knowledge exchange

What You Bring
* Relevant and applicable bachelor’s degree/diploma with a technical study background
* Longterm experience in expert roles or activities, with leadership experience
* Strong appreciation of engineering excellence and innovation ecosystems
* Proven experience in building expert networks, communities of practice, or innovation platforms
* Strong facilitation skills to mobilize experts across regions, functions, and business areas
* Fluent in English with strong communication skills and confident stakeholder engagement in global matrix organizations

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical
